an1.316:1.1: Ekapuggalo bhikkhave loke uppajjamāno uppajjati bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an1.316:1.4: so bahujanaṃ saddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā asaddhamme patiṭṭhāpeti.
an1.316:1.5: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave ekapuggalo loke uppajjamāno . . . pe . . . devamanussānanti. 2.
an1.317:1.1: Ekapuggalo bhikkhave loke uppajjamāno uppajjati bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an1.317:1.4: so bahujanaṃ asaddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā saddhamme patiṭṭhāpeti.
an1.317:1.5: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave ekapuggalo loke uppajjamāno . . . pe . . . devamanussānanti. 3.
an1.318:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi evaṃ mahāsāvajjaṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave micchādiṭṭhi.
an1.319:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekapuggalam pi samanupassāmi yo evaṃ bahujanāhitāya paṭipanno bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave Makkhali moghapuriso.
an1.319:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave nadī-mukhe khipaṃ uḍḍeyya bahunnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya vyasanāya: evam
an1.319:1.3: eva kho bhikkhave Makkhali moghapuriso manussa-khipaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahunnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya vyasanāyā ti. 5.
an1.320:1.1: Durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo ca samādapeti yañ ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
an1.321:1.1: Svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo ca samādapeti yañ ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti.
an1.322:1.1: Durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye dāyakena mattā jānitabbā no paṭiggāhakena.
an1.323:1.1: Svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye paṭiggāhakena mattā jānitabbā no dāyakena.
an1.324:1.1: Durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo āraddhaviriyo so dukkhaṃ viharati.
an1.325:1.1: Svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo kusīto so dukkhaṃ viharati.
an1.326:1.1: Durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo kusīto so sukhaṃ viharati.
an1.327:1.1: Svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo āraddhaviriyo so sukhaṃ viharati.
an1.328:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattako pi gūtho duggandho hoti
an1.328:1.2: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave appamattakam pi bhavaṃ na vaṇṇemi antamaso accharāsaṅghātamattam pī ti. 14.
an1.329:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakam pi muttaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti . . . pe . . . 15. . . . appamattako pi kheḷo duggandho hoti . . . pe . . . 16. . . . appamattako pi pubbo duggandho hoti . . . pe . . . 17. . . . appamattakam pi lohitaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti
an1.329:1.2: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave appamattakam pi bhavaṃ na vaṇṇemi antamaso accharā-saṅghāta- mattam pīti. 1.
